txpow

Search for a specific TxPoW in the unpruned chain or your mempool.

Search by txpowid, block or 0x / Mx address.

txpowid: (optional)
    TxPoW id of the TxPoW to search for.
    Returns the txpow details.

onchain: (optional)
    TxPoW id to search for on chain. Must be in the unpruned chain.
    Returns block info and number of confirmations.

block: (optional)
    Block number to search in. Must be in the unpruned chain.

address: (optional)
    0x or Mx address. Search for TxPoWs containing this specific address.

relevant: (optional)
    true or false. Only list TxPoWs relevant to this node.

max: (optional)
    Max relevant TxPoW to retrieve. Default 100.

Examples:

txpow txpowid:0x000..

txpow block:200

txpow address:0xCEF6..

txpow onchain:0x000..
